notes:
Account summary: Orbitalist Devtools builds an IDE copilot targeted at mid‑sized engineering teams. Primary ask: deterministic, reproducible code completions across releases so customers can debug regressions and pin model versions per workspace.

Key product priorities:
- Model/version pinning: they want ability to pin exact model+weights hash per release and roll back quickly. Must persist model version in telemetry and dev workspace metadata.
- Canary & rollout controls: request canary by user cohort (org unit, feature flag) + automatic rollback on eval-gate fails. Interested in Redwood's canary windows, sample sizes, and traffic split APIs.
- Eval gates: need reproducible eval harness (seeded prompts, fixed temperature, token-level diffs) to detect functional regressions in completion semantics.
- Low-latency streaming: target median token latency <60ms for single-line completions, and consistent tail latency for multi-line completions in VS Code extension.
- Cost/control: moderate sensitivity; will use Optimize recommendations for batching and KV prefix caching to reduce tokens and cost.
- Security/residency: SSO + SAML, audit logging, KMS for keys, and option to keep telemetry in EU region for specific customers.

Quote from CTO (call 2/18): "We need to be able to say exactly which model produced this suggestion and reproduce it in CI — otherwise debugging is impossible."

POC notes / findings:
- Prototype uses hosted_api with pinned model name -> good perf but want dedicated for predictable SLOs when scaling.
- First eval gate run: 12/150 test prompts triggered semantic drift vs baseline; top failure was loop-variable naming in TS snippets. SE proposed lowering temperature + deterministic sampling for gate runs.
- Integration: extension attaches model_version metadata to completions and traces to trace-id. Need Redwood to expose version hash in response and in Console logs.

Next actions:
- 1) Demo canary rollout UI + create sample canary config for Orbitalist by 2026-03-15 (owner: Maya).
- 2) Provide eval-gate template + CI integration guide (owner: Ravi).
- 3) Share Dedicated pricing baseline + latency SLO examples (sales).

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal wants clarity on IP retention and code snippets in logging (pending legal reply).
- Security wants proof of KMS integration and EU telemetry residency path.
- Need benchmark with 50 concurrent developers to validate tail latency before procurement.
